expanded_query: This course covers the fundamental concepts of linear algebra and probability, providing a solid foundation for understanding machine learning techniques. Prerequisites include a basic understanding of calculus and programming fundamentals. Topics will include vector spaces, linear transformations, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, probability distributions, conditional probability, and Bayes' theorem, as well as an introduction to matrix operations and statistical inference. Upon completion, students will be able to apply linear algebra and probability concepts to analyze and interpret machine learning models, and critically evaluate research papers in the field. The target duration for this course is approximately 6 weeks.

expanded_query: In this course, students will develop a foundational understanding of statistical concepts and methods for interpreting research studies, without requiring prior programming experience. Prerequisites include a basic understanding of algebra and a familiarity with research design and methodology. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, and case studies, students will learn to apply statistical techniques, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and regression analysis, to critically evaluate research findings and draw meaningful conclusions. This course is designed to be completed in approximately 6 weeks, with a total of 12-15 hours of instruction per week.

Course Title: Pre-Calculus and Differential Equations Fundamentals

This course is designed for students with a strong foundation in high school algebra, aiming to bridge the gap to differential equations. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, and problem-solving exercises, students will develop essential skills in pre-calculus, including functions, graphing, and analytical geometry, as well as an introduction to limits, derivatives, and basic differential equations. By the end of the course, students will have a solid understanding of the mathematical concepts and techniques necessary to tackle more advanced topics in differential equations, with a target duration of 12 weeks.

expanded_query: In this course, students will develop a comprehensive understanding of financial accounting principles and practices, enabling them to effectively read and analyze a company's annual report. Prerequisites include a basic understanding of accounting concepts and a prior course in financial management or equivalent experience. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, and case studies, students will learn to prepare and interpret financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements, as well as understand key financial ratios and metrics. This course is designed to be completed in 12 weeks, with a target of 45 hours of instruction.

Prerequisites include basic computer skills and a fundamental understanding of business operations. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, and hands-on exercises, students will gain the skills and knowledge necessary to create and implement a digital marketing plan, including social media advertising, content creation, and analytics, as well as develop a comprehensive understanding of search engine optimization (SEO), email marketing, and influencer marketing. This course is designed to be completed in approximately 6 weeks, with a total of 12-15 hours of instruction.

expanded_query: In this course, students will develop a comprehensive understanding of nutrition and healthy eating principles grounded in scientific evidence. Prerequisites include a basic understanding of human biology and prior knowledge of nutrition is not required. Through lectures, discussions, and case studies, students will learn to critically evaluate the scientific literature on nutrition and develop skills in evidence-based nutrition planning, including assessing nutritional needs, interpreting nutritional data, and applying evidence-based recommendations for healthy eating. This course is designed to be completed in 6 weeks, targeting the development of skills in nutrition assessment, evidence-based practice, and health promotion.

Prerequisites include a basic understanding of statistics and data analysis. By the end of the course, students will be well-prepared to succeed in their nursing program and pursue a career in healthcare.
